record.prompt: Create a strict 4-column by 2-row production sprite sheet on exact #FF00FF magenta, matching the supplied AISLAND vegetation, structural and resource references. Row 1: young wind-bent tropical tree, broad forked fern tree, porous dark volcanic rocks, pale layered coastal stones. Row 2: blue-gray seat and metal debris, orange life-jacket and fabric debris, broken luggage and paper debris, unique split-peak ridge monolith. Exactly eight isolated assets, equal cells, three-quarter top-down pixel art, upper-left light, no labels, grid lines, overlap, cast shadows or background variation.

postProcessing.method: magenta chroma removal, decontamination, fitted non-uniform-size atlas packing
